Radiant Burst. Attacco con arma da mischia / Attacco con arma a distanza: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Colpo:27 (4d10 + 5) Radiant damage.

Holy Word 4. wis CD 17, each enemy in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the archpriest. 21 (6d6) Radiant damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the archpriest's next turn. Half damage only.

items.name: Assassin
items.entries:
Evasion. If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

Multiattack. The assassin makes three attacks, using Shortsword or Light Crossbow in any combination.

Shortsword. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 5 ft. Colpo:7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the assassin's next turn.

Light Crossbow. Attacco con arma a distanza: +7, range 80/320 ft. Colpo:8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Poison damage.

Cunning Action. The assassin takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

items.name: Awakened Shrub
items.entries: Rake. Attacco con arma da mischia: +1, reach 5 ft. Colpo:1 Slashing damage.

items.name: Awakened Tree
items.entries: Slam. Attacco con arma da mischia: +6, reach 10 ft. Colpo:13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Axe Beak
items.entries: Beak. Attacco con arma da mischia: +4, reach 5 ft. Colpo:5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

items.name: Azer Pyromancer
items.entries:
Fire Aura. At the end of each of the azer's turns, each creature of the azer's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the azer takes 11 (2d10) Fire damage unless the azer has the Incapacitated condition.

Illumination. The azer sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

Multiattack. The azer makes two Flame Burst attacks.

Flame Burst. Attacco con arma da mischia / Attacco con arma a distanza: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Colpo:15 (2d10 + 4) Fire damage.

items.name: Azer Sentinel
items.entries:
Fire Aura. At the end of each of the azer's turns, each creature of the azer's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the azer takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage unless the azer has the Incapacitated condition.

Illumination. The azer sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

Burning Hammer. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

items.name: Baboon
items.entries:
Pack Tactics. The baboon has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the baboon's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +1, reach 5 ft. Colpo:1 (1d4 - 1) Piercing damage.

items.name: Badger
items.entries: Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +2, reach 5 ft. Colpo:1 Piercing damage.

items.name: Balor
items.entries:
Death Throes. The balor explodes when it dies. dex CD 20, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the balor. 31 (9d6) Fire damage plus 31 (9d6) Force damage. Half damage. If the balor dies outside the Abyss, it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

Fire Aura. At the end of each of the balor's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the balor takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage.

Legendary Resistance (3/Day). If the balor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Magic Resistance. The balor has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack. The balor makes one Flame Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack.

Flame Whip. Attacco con arma da mischia: +14, reach 30 ft. Colpo:18 (3d6 + 8) Force damage plus 17 (5d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the balor pulls the target up to 25 feet straight toward itself, and the target has the Prone condition.

Lightning Blade. Attacco con arma da mischia: +14, reach 10 ft. Colpo:21 (3d8 + 8) Force damage plus 22 (4d10) Lightning damage, and the target can't take Reactions until the start of the balor's next turn.

Teleport. The balor teleports itself or a willing demon within 10 feet of itself up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the balor can see.

items.name: Bandit
items.entries:
Scimitar. Attacco con arma da mischia: +3, reach 5 ft. Colpo:4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

Light Crossbow. Attacco con arma a distanza: +3, range 80/320 ft. Colpo:5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

items.name: Bandit Captain
items.entries:
Multiattack. The bandit makes two attacks, using Scimitar and Pistol in any combination.

Scimitar. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

Pistol. Attacco con arma a distanza: +5, range 30/90 ft. Colpo:8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.

Parry. The bandit is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. The bandit adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

items.name: Bandit Crime Lord
items.entries:
Evasion. If the bandit is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the bandit instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

Multiattack. The bandit makes three attacks, using Scimitar or Pistol in any combination.

Scimitar. Attacco con arma da mischia: +9, reach 5 ft. Colpo:12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

Pistol. Attacco con arma a distanza: +9, range 30/90 ft. Colpo:10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

Deadly Aim. The bandit gives itself Advantage on the next attack roll it makes during the current turn. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra 28 (8d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Bandit Deceiver
items.entries:
Multiattack. The bandit makes three Dagger attacks.

Dagger. Attacco con arma da mischia / Attacco con arma a distanza: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Colpo:8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

Blinding Flash 4. con CD 14, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the bandit can see within 120 feet. 13 (3d6 + 3) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the bandit's next turn. Half damage only.

items.name: Banshee
items.entries:
Detect Life. The banshee magically senses the direction of creatures up to 1 mile away that aren't Constructs or Undead.

Incorporeal Movement. The banshee can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Multiattack. The banshee makes two Corrupting Touch attacks and uses Horrify.

Corrupting Touch. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:7 (1d8 + 3) Necrotic damage.

Horrify. wis CD 13, one creature the banshee can see within 60 feet that can see the banshee. The target has the Frightened condition until the start of the banshee's next turn. The target is immune to this banshee's Horrify for 24 hours.

Deathly Wail (1/Day). The banshee releases a mournful wail if it isn't in sunlight. con CD 13, each creature within 30 feet that can hear the wail and isn't a Construct or an Undead. If the target has 25 Hit Points or fewer, it drops to 0 Hit Points. Otherwise, the target takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

items.name: Barbed Devil
items.entries:
Barbed Hide. At the start of each of its turns, the devil deals 5 (1d10) Piercing damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

Diabolical Restoration. If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

Magic Resistance. The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack. The devil makes one Claws attack and one Tail attack, or it makes two Hurl Flame attacks.

Claws. Attacco con arma da mischia: +6, reach 5 ft. Colpo:10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape CD 13) from both claws.

Tail. Attacco con arma da mischia: +6, reach 10 ft. Colpo:14 (2d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

Hurl Flame. Attacco con arma a distanza: +5, range 150 ft. Colpo:17 (5d6) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

items.name: Barlgura
items.entries:
Demonic Restoration. If the barlgura dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

Multiattack. The barlgura makes one Tormenting Bite attack and two Thrash attacks.

Tormenting Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 5 ft. Colpo:11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) Psychic damage.

Thrash. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 5 ft. Colpo:9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Leap. The barlgura jumps up to 40 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

items.name: Basilisk
items.entries:
Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

Petrifying Gaze 4. con CD 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone . If the basilisk sees its reflection within the Cone , the basilisk must make this save. 1 The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. 2 The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

items.name: Bat
items.entries: Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Colpo:1 Piercing damage.

items.name: Bearded Devil
items.entries:
Magic Resistance. The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack. The devil makes one Beard attack and one Infernal Glaive attack.

Beard. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the devil's next turn. Until this poison ends, the target can't regain Hit Points.

Infernal Glaive. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 10 ft. Colpo:8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature and doesn't already have an infernal wound, it is subjected to the following effect. con CD 12. The target receives an infernal wound. While wounded, the target loses 5 (1d10) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a CD 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

items.name: Behir
items.entries:
Multiattack. The behir makes one Bite attack and uses Constrict.

Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +10, reach 10 ft. Colpo:19 (2d12 + 6) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Lightning damage.

Constrict. str CD 18, one Large or smaller creature the behir can see within 5 feet. 28 (5d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape CD 16), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

Lightning Breath 5. dex CD 16, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line . 66 (12d10) Lightning damage. Half damage.

Swallow. dex CD 18, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the behir (the behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time). The behir swallows the target, which is no longer Grappled. While swallowed, a creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and takes 21 (6d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns.

If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a CD 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the behir and has the Prone condition. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

items.name: Beholder
items.entries:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair). If the beholder fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack. The beholder uses Eye Rays three times.

Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +8, reach 5 ft. Colpo:13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

Eye Rays. The beholder randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet of itself (roll 1d10; reroll if the beholder has already used that ray during this turn):

1: Charm Ray. wis CD 16. 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition for 1 hour or until it takes damage. Half damage only.
2: Paralyzing Ray. con CD 16. The target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
3: Fear Ray. wis CD 16. 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Half damage only.
4: Slowing Ray. con CD 16. 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target's Speed is halved; the target can't take Reactions; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. Half damage only.
5: Enervation Ray. con CD 16. 13 (3d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points. Half damage only.
6: Telekinetic Ray. str CD 16 (the target succeeds automatically if it is Gargantuan). The beholder moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction. The target has the Restrained condition until the start of the beholder's next turn or until the beholder has the Incapacitated condition. The beholder can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a tool or opening a door or container.
7: Sleep Ray. wis CD 16 (the target succeeds automatically if it is a Construct or an Undead). The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. The condition ends if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.
8: Petrification Ray. con CD 16. 1 The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. 2 The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.
9: Disintegration Ray. dex CD 16. 36 (8d8) Force damage. If the target is a nonmagical object or a creation of magical force, a 10-foot Cube of it disintegrates into dust. Half damage. If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into dust.
10: Death Ray. dex CD 16. 55 (10d10) Necrotic damage. Half damage. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 Hit Points.

Antimagic Cone. The beholder's central eye emits an antimagic wave in a 150-foot Cone . Until the start of the beholder's next turn, that area acts as an Antimagic Field spell, and that area works against the beholder's own Eye Rays.

legendary.name: Beholder
legendary.entries:
The region containing a beholder's lair is twisted by its presence, creating the following effects:

Scopophobia. Creatures within 1 mile of the lair feel as if they're being watched. Any creature (excluding the beholder and its allies) that finishes a Short Rest while within 1 mile of the lair must succeed on a CD 13 Wisdom saving throw or gain no benefit from that rest.
Warping Terrain. Minor warps in reality occur near the lair; any creature (excluding the beholder) within 1 mile of the lair that makes a D20 Test and rolls a 1 has the Prone condition.

If the beholder dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

items.name: Beholder Zombie
items.entries:
Undead Fortitude. If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (CD 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Points instead.

Multiattack. The zombie uses Eye Rays twice.

Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:16 (4d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

Eye Rays. The zombie randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet of itself (roll 1d4; reroll if the zombie has already used that ray during this turn):

1: Paralyzing Ray. con CD 14. The target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
2: Fear Ray. wis CD 14. 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.
3: Enervation Ray. con CD 14. 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points. Half damage only.
4: Disintegration Ray. dex CD 14. 27 (5d10) Force damage. If the target is a nonmagical object or a creation of magical force, a 10-foot Cube of it disintegrates into dust. Half damage. If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into dust.

items.name: Berserker
items.entries:
Bloodied Frenzy. While Bloodied, the berserker has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

Greataxe. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:9 (1d12 + 3) Slashing damage.

items.name: Berserker Commander
items.entries:
Bloodied Frenzy. While Bloodied, the berserker has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

Multiattack. The berserker makes three attacks, using Greataxe or Javelin in any combination.

Greataxe. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 5 ft. Colpo:10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage, plus 10 (3d6) Thunder damage to the target or another creature within 5 feet of the target.

Javelin. Attacco con arma da mischia / Attacco con arma a distanza: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Colpo:18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 5 feet until the start of the berserker's next turn.

Frenzied Rush. Each ally within 30 feet of the berserker can take a Reaction to move up to half the ally's Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack. The berserker can also move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack.

items.name: Black Bear
items.entries:
Multiattack. The bear makes two Rend attacks.

Rend. Attacco con arma da mischia: +4, reach 5 ft. Colpo:5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

items.name: Black Dragon Wyrmling
items.entries:
Amphibious. The dragon can breathe air and water.

Multiattack. The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

Rend. Attacco con arma da mischia: +4, reach 5 ft. Colpo:5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Acid damage.

Acid Breath 5. dex CD 11, each creature in a 15-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line . 22 (5d8) Acid damage. Half damage.

items.name: Black Pudding
items.entries:
Amorphous. The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

Corrosive Form. A creature that hits the pudding with a melee attack roll takes 4 (1d8) Acid damage. Nonmagical ammunition is destroyed immediately after hitting the pudding and dealing any damage. Any nonmagical weapon takes a cumulative -1 penalty to attack rolls immediately after dealing damage to the pudding and coming into contact with it. The weapon is destroyed if the penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the weapon.

In 1 minute, the pudding can eat through 2 feet of nonmagical wood or metal.

Spider Climb. The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Dissolving Pseudopod. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 10 ft. Colpo:17 (4d6 + 3) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor.

Split. While the pudding is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. The pudding splits into two new Black Puddings. Each new pudding is one size smaller than the original pudding and acts on its Initiative. The original pudding's Hit Points are divided evenly between the new puddings (round down).

items.name: Blink Dog
items.entries:
Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

Teleport 4. The dog teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

items.name: Blob of Annihilation
items.entries:
Astral Implosion. If the blob is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it implodes and ejects any creatures and objects engulfed by it into the Astral Sea. The blob itself vanishes, leaving behind a layer of slime on everything that was within 600 feet of it. In 1d20 years, the blob reconstitutes on a random world in the Material Plane.

Legendary Resistance (4/Day). If the blob fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Magic Resistance. The blob has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack. The blob makes two Pseudopod attacks and uses Engulf. It can replace one attack with a use of Restraining Glob.

Pseudopod. Attacco con arma da mischia: +15, reach 30 ft. Colpo:24 (3d10 + 8) Force damage.

Engulf. The blob moves up to its Speed and can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures and objects. str CD 23, each creature or object whose space the blob enters for the first time during this move. The target is engulfed. While engulfed, a target has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the blob, and when the blob moves, the engulfed target moves with it. A nonmagical object is destroyed after spending 1 minute engulfed.

While engulfed, a creature takes 21 (6d6) Force damage at the start of each of its turns, is suffocating, has the Restrained condition, and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. An engulfed creature that is reduced to 0 Hit Points dissolves into ash, which is ejected into the Astral Sea. The target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

Restraining Glob. The blob lobs a slimy glob at one Large or smaller creature it can see within 600 feet of itself. dex CD 23, the targeted creature. 18 (3d6 + 8) Acid damage. The glob rolls the target 60 feet straight toward the blob, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn, when the glob harmlessly dissolves. Half damage only.

items.name: Blood Hawk
items.entries:
Pack Tactics. The hawk has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hawk's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Beak. Attacco con arma da mischia: +4, reach 5 ft. Colpo:4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage if the target is Bloodied.

items.name: Blue Dragon Wyrmling
items.entries:
Multiattack. The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

Rend. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Lightning damage.

Lightning Breath 5. dex CD 12, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line . 21 (6d6) Lightning damage. Half damage.

items.name: Blue Slaad
items.entries:
Magic Resistance. The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Points.

Multiattack. The slaad makes three Mutating Claw attacks.

Mutating Claw. Attacco con arma da mischia: +8, reach 10 ft. Colpo:12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a slaad, it is subjected to the following effect. con CD 15. The target is cursed. The cursed target can't regain Hit Points, and its Hit Points maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) after every 24 hours and doesn't return to normal after finishing a Long Rest. If the curse reduces the target's Hit Points maximum to 0, the curse ends, and instead of dying, the target instantly transforms into a Red Slaad or, if it can cast spells of level 3 or higher, a Green Slaad. Only a Wish spell can reverse this transformation.

items.name: Boar
items.entries:
Bloodied Fury. While Bloodied, the boar has Advantage on attack rolls.

Gore. Attacco con arma da mischia: +3, reach 5 ft. Colpo:4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

items.name: Bone Devil
items.entries:
Diabolical Restoration. If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

Magic Resistance. The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack. The devil makes two Claw attacks and one Infernal Sting attack.

Claw. Attacco con arma da mischia: +8, reach 10 ft. Colpo:13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

Infernal Sting. Attacco con arma da mischia: +8, reach 10 ft. Colpo:15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the devil's next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points.

items.name: Bone Naga
items.entries:
Multiattack. The naga makes two Bite attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Serpentine Gaze.

Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 10 ft. Colpo:10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

Serpentine Gaze. wis CD 13, one creature the naga can see within 60 feet. 13 (3d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the naga's next turn.

items.name: Brass Dragon Wyrmling
items.entries:
Rend. Attacco con arma da mischia: +4, reach 5 ft. Colpo:7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.

Fire Breath 5. dex CD 11, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line . 14 (4d6) Fire damage. Half damage.

Sleep Breath. con CD 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone . The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it repeats the save. 2 The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. This effect ends for the target if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

items.name: Brazen Gorgon
items.entries:
Flame Aura. At the end of each of the gorgon's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the gorgon takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage.

Illumination. The gorgon sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

Multiattack. The gorgon makes two Gore attacks.

Gore. Attacco con arma da mischia: +8, reach 5 ft. Colpo:11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

Smelting Charge 5. The gorgon moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each time the gorgon enters a creature's space for the first time during this move, that target is subjected to the following effect. dex CD 16. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Fire damage, and the target is pulled into the gorgon's space and has the Grappled condition (escape CD 14); if the gorgon already has a creature Grappled, the target has the Prone condition instead. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition. When the gorgon moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing no extra movement.

items.name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling
items.entries:
Amphibious. The dragon can breathe air and water.

Multiattack. The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

Rend. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

Lightning Breath 5. dex CD 12, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line . 16 (3d10) Lightning damage. Half damage.

Repulsion Breath. str CD 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone . The target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the dragon and has the Prone condition.

items.name: Brown Bear
items.entries:
Multiattack. The bear makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

Claw. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

items.name: Bugbear Stalker
items.entries:
Abduct. The bugbear needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

Multiattack. The bugbear makes two Javelin or Morningstar attacks.

Javelin. Attacco con arma da mischia / Attacco con arma a distanza: +5, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Colpo:13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

Morningstar. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. Colpo:12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

Quick Grapple. dex CD 13, one Medium or smaller creature the bugbear can see within 10 feet. The target has the Grappled condition (escape CD 13).

items.name: Bugbear Warrior
items.entries:
Abduct. The bugbear needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

Grab. Attacco con arma da mischia: +4, reach 10 ft. Colpo:9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape CD 12).

Light Hammer. Attacco con arma da mischia / Attacco con arma a distanza: +4 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Colpo:9 (3d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Bulette

Longbow. Attacco con arma a distanza: +4, range 150/600 ft. Colpo:6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

Trampling Charge 5. The centaur moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space the centaur enters is targeted once by the following effect. str CD 14. 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

items.name: Centaur Warden
items.entries:

Sun Ray. Attacco con arma a distanza: +7, range 90 ft. Colpo:14 (3d6 + 4) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the centaur's next turn.

Entangling Trail 5. The centaur moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack. Each creature within 5 feet of the centaur as it moves is targeted once by the following effect. str CD 15. 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Chain Devil
items.entries:
Diabolical Restoration. If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

Magic Resistance. The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack. The devil makes two Chain attacks and uses Conjure Infernal Chain.

Chain. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 10 ft. Colpo:11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape CD 14) from one of two chains, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

Conjure Infernal Chain. The devil conjures a fiery chain to bind a creature. dex CD 15, one creature the devil can see within 60 feet. 9 (2d4 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the devil's next turn, at which point the chain disappears. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. The chain disappears.

Unnerving Gaze. A creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and can see the devil. dwis CD 15, the triggering creature. The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its turn. The target is immune to this devil's Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.

items.name: Chasme
items.entries:
Demonic Restoration. If the chasme dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

Magic Resistance. The chasme has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Spider Climb. The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Proboscis. Attacco con arma da mischia: +5, reach 5 ft. Colpo:16 (4d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Points maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

Drone. con CD 12, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the chasme (demons automatically succeed on this save). The target has the Unconscious condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. The target succeeds automatically after 10 minutes or if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to empty a flask of Holy Water on it. The target is immune to this chasme's Drone for 24 hours.

items.name: Chimera
items.entries:
Multiattack. The chimera makes one Ram attack, one Bite attack, and one Claw attack. It can replace the Claw attack with a use of Fire Breath if available.

Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 5 ft. Colpo:11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage if the chimera had Advantage on the attack roll.

Claw. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 5 ft. Colpo:7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Ram. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 5 ft. Colpo:10 (1d12 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Fire Breath 5. dex CD 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone . 31 (7d8) Fire damage. Half damage.

items.name: Chuul
items.entries:
Amphibious. The chuul can breathe air and water.

Sense Magic. The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the Detect Magic spell but isn't itself magical.

Multiattack. The chuul makes two Pincer attacks and uses Paralyzing Tentacles.

Pincer. Attacco con arma da mischia: +6, reach 10 ft. Colpo:9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape CD 14) from one of two pincers.

Paralyzing Tentacles. con CD 13, one creature Grappled by the chuul. The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

items.name: Clay Golem
items.entries:
Acid Absorption. Whenever the golem is subjected to Acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Acid damage dealt.

Berserk. Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to be berserk until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.

Immutable Form. The golem can't shape-shift.

Magic Resistance. The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack. The golem makes two Slam attacks, or it makes three Slam attacks if it used Hasten this turn.

Slam. Attacco con arma da mischia: +9, reach 5 ft. Colpo:10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) Acid damage, and the target's Hit Points maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Acid damage taken.

Hasten 5. The golem takes the Dash and Disengage actions.

items.name: Cloaker
items.entries:
Light Sensitivity. While in Bright Light, the cloaker has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

Multiattack. The cloaker makes one Attach attack and two Tail attacks.

Attach. Attacco con arma da mischia: +6, reach 5 ft. Colpo:13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the cloaker attaches to it. While the cloaker is attached, the target has the Blinded condition, and the cloaker can't make Attach attacks against other targets. In addition, the cloaker halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.

The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to detach the cloaker, doing so by succeeding on a CD 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

Tail. Attacco con arma da mischia: +6, reach 10 ft. Colpo:8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

Moan. wis CD 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the cloaker. The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the cloaker's next turn. The target is immune to this cloaker's Moan for the next 24 hours.

items.name: Cloud Giant
items.entries:

Thunderous Mace. Attacco con arma da mischia: +12, reach 10 ft. Colpo:21 (3d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.

Thundercloud. Attacco con arma a distanza: +12, range 240 ft. Colpo:18 (3d6 + 8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Cockatrice
items.entries: Petrifying Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +3, reach 5 ft. Colpo:3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. con CD 11. 1 The target has the Restrained condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. 2 The target has the Petrified condition, instead of the Restrained condition, for 24 hours.

items.name: Cockatrice Regent
items.entries:
Flyby. The cockatrice doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

Multiattack. The cockatrice makes one Petrifying Bite attack and two Talons attacks.

Petrifying Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 5 ft. Colpo:13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. con CD 14. 1 The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. 2 The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

Talons. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 5 ft. Colpo:18 (4d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Magical Backlash. A creature within 120 feet of the cockatrice deals damage to it. ddex CD 14, the triggering creature. 13 (3d6 + 3) Force damage.

items.name: Colossus
items.entries:
Immutable Form. The colossus can't shape-shift.

Legendary Resistance (4/Day). If the colossus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Magic Resistance. The colossus has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Siege Monster. The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack. The colossus makes three attacks, using Slam or Radiant Ray in any combination.

Slam. Attacco con arma da mischia: +18, reach 20 ft. Colpo:32 (4d10 + 10) Bludgeoning damage, and the colossus pushes the target up to 20 feet straight away from itself.

Radiant Ray. Attacco con arma a distanza: +18, range 300 ft. Colpo:22 (4d10) Radiant damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Divine Beam 5. dex CD 26, each creature in a 300-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line . 65 (10d12) Radiant damage. Half damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this beam disintegrates into dust, leaving behind any magic items it was wearing or carrying.

items.name: Commoner
items.entries:
Training. The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

Club. Attacco con arma da mischia: +2, reach 5 ft. Colpo:2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.

Constrict. str CD 12, one Medium or smaller creature the snake can see within 5 feet. 7 (3d4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape CD 12).

items.name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling
items.entries:
Rend. Attacco con arma da mischia: +4, reach 5 ft. Colpo:7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.

Acid Breath 5. dex CD 11, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line . 18 (4d8) Acid damage. Half damage.

Slowing Breath. con CD 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone . The target can't take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Couatl
items.entries:
Shielded Mind. The couatl's thoughts can't be read by any means, and other creatures can communicate with it telepathically only if it allows them.

Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +7, reach 5 ft. Colpo:11 (1d12 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the couatl's next turn.

Constrict. str CD 15, one Medium or smaller creature the couatl can see within 5 feet. 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape CD 13), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

items.name: Crab
items.entries:
Amphibious. The crab can breathe air and water.

Claw. Attacco con arma da mischia: +2, reach 5 ft. Colpo:1 Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Crawling Claw

Bite. Attacco con arma da mischia: +4, reach 5 ft. Colpo:6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape CD 12). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

items.name: Cultist Fanatic
items.entries: Pact Blade. Attacco con arma da mischia: +4, reach 5 ft. Colpo:6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

items.entries:
